设  
\[
U=\frac{1}{\sigma^2}\sum_{i=1}^6 X_i^2,\qquad 
V=\frac{1}{\sigma^2}\sum_{j=1}^6 X_{j+6}^2
\]
由于 \(X_i\sim N(0,\sigma^2)\) 且独立，有  
\[
U\sim \chi^2(6),\quad V\sim \chi^2(6)
\]
且 \(U,V\) 独立。因此
\[
Y=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^6X_i^2}{\sum_{j=1}^6X_{j+6}^2}
=\frac{U}{V}
=\frac{U/6}{V/6}
\]
所以
\[
Y\sim F(6,6)
\]

答案：D
